boss_battles: Countdown: the Today card and Boss Arena screen show a ring with 'Boss in N days' from program Day 1 (boss days on Day 1 and Day 3 of weeks 4, 8, 12; a light Day 1 'Recon' baseline covers push-ups, plank, 1-min bodyweight squats and 1-mile time so tiers and ghosts exist from the start). The 3 sessions before a boss day are 'Training Camp': ghosts frozen (no bar raise), lighter volume, camp banner. Boss Week Day 1 = STRENGTH BOSS: (1) Push-up max reps, strict, one set: Iron 0-4, Bronze 5, Silver 10, Gold 20, Platinum 30, Diamond 40, Warrior 50. (2) Goblet squat 53 lb max unbroken reps (0 = Iron; the app records 35 lb DB reps as a sub-score for the ghost but tiers are on the 53 only): Bronze 1, Silver 6, Gold 11, Platinum 16, Diamond 21, Warrior 31. (3) Suitcase carry 53 lb, seconds per hand, score = min(left, right): Bronze 20, Silver 40, Gold 60, Platinum 90, Diamond 120, Warrior 180. (4) Plank hold seconds: Bronze 30, Silver 60, Gold 90, Platinum 120, Diamond 180, Warrior 240. Boss Week Day 3 = ENGINE BOSS: (5) 1-mile treadmill time (0% incline, any run/walk): Bronze < 15:00, Silver < 12:00, Gold < 10:00, Platinum < 9:00, Diamond < 8:00, Warrior < 7:00. (6) 5-minute KB swing test, 53 lb, total reps, any rest (locked until the swing form ladder is cleared, shown as 'Sealed' with the unlock rule): Bronze 30, Silver 50, Gold 75, Platinum 100, Diamond 125, Warrior 150. Each boss card shows current tier medal, the number needed for the next tier, and your Recon/previous result as the Ghost. Scoring: +150 XP per tier gained, +50 per attempt; the Boss Season is WON with >= 2 total promotions (week 4 auto-WIN 'First Blood'). Result screen: a 'BOSS DEFEATED' or 'BOSS SURVIVED' stamp, medal upgrades animating on the body map, and the week-8/12 projection ('At this pace: Gold push-ups by Boss 3'). Safety gates in data: goblet and swing tests require the corresponding ladder rung >= the loaded variant; push-up max stops at form break (user taps stop); all tests are single attempts with a 3-minute rest between.
body_map: A front/back silhouette (single SVG, 9 clickable path groups: chest, shoulders, arms, back, core, glutes, quads, hamstrings_calves, and a heart icon for cardio) sits on the Home tab under the Ghost race and fills the Body screen. Every set's Work Score is split into regions by the exercise's regions weights; region level = floor(sqrt(region_xp/60)); regions fill from grey (0-2) to bronze (3-5), silver (6-8), gold (9-11), platinum (12-14), diamond (15+), with a thin animated fill line showing progress to the next level. Today's trained regions pulse for 2 s on the Session Result screen and show a small '+level' tag if they levelled. Benchmark tiers overlay as medal pins: push-ups pin on chest, goblet on quads, carry on arms/core, plank on core, mile on heart, swings on glutes. The weakest region gets a dashed outline and appears once a week as a 'Number to beat' so the map drives balance head to toe. Tapping a region shows its level, XP to next, top-3 feeding exercises, and days since last PR in that region. Milestone: all nine regions at Gold turns the whole silhouette gold with the 'Gold Head to Toe' badge.
first_7_days_experience: Day 0 (setup, 2 min): ask vest weight, whether dumbbells are pairs, treadmill max incline; pick rest day. Day 1 'Recon' (Mon): light baseline in-session (push-up max, plank, 1-min bodyweight squats, 1-mile walk/jog) plus a short beginner circuit at Trainer Ghost 0.9x targets; the user sees First Blood, their first tiers (mostly Iron/Bronze, framed as 'starting tiers, every one goes up'), reaches level 2 in one session, and the body map lights chest/core/heart bronze. Day 2 (Tue): first real match vs Trainer Ghost; pre-filled sets mean the whole log is ~12 taps; almost certainly a WIN (+50) and 1-3 PRs since everything is new (cap 3); level 3-4. Day 3 (Wed): KB hinge/deadlift rung and incline treadmill; 'Vest Up' hint shows what rung unlocks the vest; first ladder step is likely on Day 4-5 because week-1 targets are deliberately at the bottom of ranges. Day 4 (Thu): Boss Arena tab surfaces 'Boss in 24 days' with the six cards and the swing test 'Sealed' (unlock rule visible), turning week 3's form work into a quest. Day 5 (Fri): first Quick Strike suggestion if the session is started after 8 pm ('15 min? Take a Quick Strike'). Day 6 (Sat): the scoreboard shows Season 1 nearly complete: 'Finish today for a Shield'. Day 7 (Sun, rest): opening the app auto-logs Rest, shows the first Warrior Report Card (expected B/A on Attendance, A on Strength thanks to first ladder steps, C-B Engine, A Ghost Record), a title, the Shield earned, 'Week One Warrior' badge, level ~9-10 'Fighter' within reach, and the three Numbers to beat in Season 2 (now against real Ghosts). Everything in the first week is engineered so the user wins visibly (early wins) while the score already comes from work, not attendance.
anti_patterns_deliberately_avoided: No daily streak reset on a single miss: Shields auto-apply and a 48 h Reclaim window exists, because a beginner's day-7 dropout cliff is where hard resets do the most damage.
No leaderboards or comparison against other people: every opponent is the user's own past week (self-referenced goals sustain motivation and lower burnout).
No XP for opening the app, watching, or tapping through screens: XP is only earned by work, ghosts, PRs, ladders, tiers, and attendance.
No incentive to train on the rest day or 7 days a week: rest day scores 0 XP but keeps the streak; season WIN requires >= 4.5 sessions, not 7.

No 'beat the ghost at any cost' arms race: ghost is beaten by +1 point, dominate caps at 110%, PRs cap at 3 per session, camp weeks freeze ghosts, and a LOSS never lowers next week's bar or adds a penalty.
No assuming equipment you do not own: weight chips only show 8/10/12/20/35/53 and the vest; ladders bridge gaps with reps, tempo, pauses, unilateral and vest rungs.
No benchmark on untrained skills: swing and goblet tests are sealed behind form-ladder rungs so week 4 cannot injure a beginner.
No exponential level curve or paywall-style loot: level cost grows ~L^1.6 so levelling stays visible in week 12, and every reward is earned, never bought.
No shame states: a bad week is 'Regroup' with a 3-item plan; a broken streak yields the Comeback badge; the weakest body region is framed as the next target.
No dependence on notifications: all motivation is on-open (race bar, countdown, numbers to beat, report card), since a static GitHub Pages PWA cannot push.
